title: rubus × gothicus var. lidforssii
intro: Rubus × gothicus var. lidforssii, commonly known as the black thorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The black thorn plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents present in Rubus × gothicus var. lidforssii include ellagic acid, which has been shown to have therapeutic actions such as protecting against cancer and cardiovascular disease.
